title: Schema docs is not implemented
body: The repository includes `docs/output_schema.md`, documenting the output schema for analysis, engagement, growth, and export rows. The document must enumerate every exported field using snake_case names. `docs/output_schema.md` documents every field in markdown tables whose first column is the field name wrapped in backticks, for example a row like `| user_id | int | ... |` should be written with `user_id` backticked in the first column, so each documented field name is parseable as the first backticked token of a table row. Non-field type names or implementation identifiers should not be backticked unless they are listed in a field-name column.
acceptance_hint: 3 executable checks over the schema_docs surface.
